name: blind-spots
description: After a long turn, a reviewer pass flags above the prompt the one decision, risk, gap or concept you are likely to have missed, and learns from how you react.

minToolCalls.title: Minimum tool calls
minToolCalls.description: The base threshold: a finished turn is reviewed only if the main agent made at least this many tool calls in it. The plugin raises it for a project while you ignore findings there. Each review re-sends the conversation to the model.
